entries.80b638400b51b184: In the medium-term management plan (rolling) announced on June 22, 2026, covering the fiscal years ending March 2027 to March 2029, the company positions the fiscal year ending March 2027 as a year of reinvestment and infrastructure development for future growth, and aims to recover the results from the fiscal year ending March 2028 onward. Centered on the printed circuit board e-commerce service 'P-ban.com', the company is pursuing business expansion by integrating component mounting, electronic component procurement and component inventory management with mounting coordination under 'GUGEN Hub', and by expanding peripheral areas such as AI and development support services, thereby supporting the entire process of customer development, prototyping and productization. The company has opened 'p-ban Thailand', an online printed circuit board store for Thailand, and is also advancing into the ASEAN market.

entries.cf8c2aef485a10bc: This is a single segment centered on the operation of "P-ban.com", an e-commerce service for printed circuit boards. Based on the board specifications a customer selects on the Web, it automatically selects the factory that is optimal in price, delivery time and quality from among domestic and overseas partner suppliers, and presents quotations matched to multiple delivery time courses. Customers can place an order simply by choosing a quotation and delivery time and uploading their design drawings. The company operates as a fabless business and has no factory of its own. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,311 million, of which E-commerce services accounted for ¥2,200 million and other for ¥110 million. It has also opened "p-ban Thailand", an online shopping site for the Kingdom of Thailand.
entries.ddd339940afe7544: It operates the E-commerce site 'P-ban.com', where printed circuit board design, manufacturing and component mounting can be ordered together on the Web. It operates on a fabless basis without its own factories, automatically selecting partner factories in Japan and overseas to match customer specifications and presenting quotes for multiple delivery-time courses. It also provides peripheral services such as metal masks, enclosures and harnesses, and the R&D support service 'gene'.
